answer: To claim a reward, an account first receives a one-time whisper word and, in one hour, must write an original fourteen-line sonnet using that word, signed with its key. Only one sonnet is allowed per thirty-day horizon. Two reviewers check the text, signature, and timestamp within 24 hours against a public record of earlier sonnets. A copied or late sonnet is rejected and the account is frozen. One honest person spends ten minutes on one sonnet, while 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 sonnets in one hour, each with a different word.
